name: kamalduo
description: Sinatra application example for Kamal 2, including health checks and VPS walkthroughs.
details: Includes /healthz, Docker setup, CI and secrets notes plus deployment instructions for multiple VPS providers.
best_for: You want a concrete non-Rails Kamal 2 example.
caveat: Demonstration settings are a learning aid, not drop-in production defaults.

name: Kamal frontend/backend demo
description: Example of separate Bun/Node frontend and backend services with a database on one Kamal host.
details: Shows how multiple HTTP apps and hostnames can share a server in a configuration beyond the typical single Rails app.
best_for: You deploy frontend and API services separately.
caveat: The example database is provisioned but not fully exercised by the app.

name: GhostCMS on Kamal and Hetzner
description: Community Ghost CMS deployment example using Kamal on Hetzner.
details: A reference for containerizing and deploying a CMS rather than a Ruby or Node application template.
best_for: You are adapting Kamal to self-hosted content publishing.
caveat: Verify current Ghost image and Kamal compatibility before reusing scripts.

name: kamal-quake
description: QuakeJS browser-game deployment example using Kamal.
details: A playful example showing that Kamal can ship a containerized app outside its Rails origins.
best_for: You want an approachable deployment demo.
caveat: Educational example, not production operations tooling.

name: grimmory-kamal
description: Kamal configuration example for a self-hosted library application.
details: A real app's deployment files that can help compare Docker and Kamal choices with your own setup.
best_for: You learn best by reading other applications' deploy configs.
caveat: Its configuration reflects one project's environment and may need updating.

name: Embeddings inference accessory
description: Example of an embeddings inference workload deployed alongside a Kamal app.
details: Explores deployment of an AI-support service as an accessory-like process.
best_for: You are planning an additional inference service in a self-hosted stack.
caveat: Review resource consumption and persistence independently.

name: django-emojivote
description: Django sample application with deployment-related files.
details: A small Python web app that can be inspected when exploring non-Rails Kamal practices.
best_for: You want to inspect another framework's deployment layout.
caveat: This is an example application, not a reusable deployment tool.
